scripts.check: bun run prepare:data && bun run validate:content && astro check && bun run test:links && bun run test:public-safety && bun run test:agent-index
scripts.build: bun run check && astro build && bun scripts/verify-redirect-artifact.mjs && bun scripts/verify-analytics-artifact.mjs
scripts.preview: bun run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy:preview: bun run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=lazurio-documentation --branch=preview
scripts.deploy:production: bun scripts/assert-production-gate.mjs && bun run build:production && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=lazurio-documentation --branch=main
